explanation: Compared against OEIS A219838 (Sun's general conjecture): for each prime p, every sufficiently large n is x + y (x, y > 0) with ((xy)^p - 1)/(xy - 1) prime. Natural division is exact because xy - 1 | (xy)^p - 1. The degenerate xy = 1 gives 0/0 = 0, which is not prime and so harmless. Faithful.
